summary.en: Israel has built new road networks and opened bases in southern Lebanon while striking Qantara and conducting overflights that wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65‑year-old retired engineer. Hezbollah has arrested five members in Batroun, continued artillery fire on Israeli positions and begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. Former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was killed in Beirut. France opened a probe into alleged Israeli war crimes and protests against Israeli attacks occurred in Sweden. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel har bygget nye veinett og åpnet baser i sørlige Libanon mens de har angrepet Qantara og gjennomført overflyvninger som såret en libanesisk fotballspiller og førte til at en 65‑år gammel pensjonert ingeniør ble arrestert. Hezbollah har arrestert fem medlemmer i Batroun, fortsatt artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og begynt å betale kontantstøtte til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. Den tidligere irakiske stortingsrepresentanten Ahmed al-Alwani ble drept i Beirut. Frankrike har åpnet en etterforskning av påståtte israelske krigsforbrytelser og protester mot israelske angrep fant sted i Sverige. Konflikten forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
